summary: With all four registered questions now carrying decided accounts and complete comparison sets, this final update makes the parent finding's measured effect durable in the same form as the other two findings: one behavior entry citing the four receipts that decided it. It records that a follower which accepts an InstallSnapshot whose index does not exceed its cached last log entry never accepts another entry from that leader — the cached claim keeps outranking the installed snapshot in getLastEntry, every prev-log check fails, the leader walks nextIndex down until it cannot read its trimmed log and re-ships the same snapshot — with the measured numbers across three and five voters and three-, four- and ten-second windows (restores 4 -> 1193 and 5 -> 4788, applied index fixed at the snapshot index while the frontier advanced 83 -> 95 and 83 -> 123, commit index 0, claim persisting), the monotonic-store variant where the store was emptied while the claim persisted, and the repair boundary where a snapshot at 98 against a claim of 97 restored the follower. Conditions, sources and execution indices are attached, so later work can reuse or correct it by revision. No account changed, no question reopened and no experiment requested; remaining unmeasured ground stays recorded as limitation in the parent interpretation (in-process store and snapshot implementations only, horizons beyond ten seconds, bounded write rate, and the child questions' own bounds).
